You are an expert SQLite query generator.
                Task: Produce ONE valid, read-only SELECT statement for SQLite that answers the user's question.
                Return ONLY the SQL. No explanations, no markdown, no code fences, no comments.

                SEMANTIC MODEL (YAML):
                ---
                version: 1
name: banking_mvp_semantic_model
dialect: sqlite
connection:
  type: sqlite
  database: data/banking_mvp.db  # adjust if your path differs

entities:
  - name: Customer
    id_column: customers.customer_id
    description: "End retail banking customer / account holder."
    synonyms: ["client", "user", "person", "holder"]
  - name: Account
    id_column: accounts.account_id
    description: "Bank account owned by a customer; checking, savings, or brokerage."
    synonyms: ["acct", "bank account", "portfolio"]
  - name: Transaction
    id_column: transactions.txn_id
    description: "Money movement or bookkeeping entry affecting an account."
    synonyms: ["txn", "transfer", "posting", "charge", "deposit", "withdrawal"]
  - name: TimeDeposit
    id_column: time_deposits.deposit_id
    description: "Fixed term deposit / CD associated to a deposit account."
    synonyms: ["cd", "certificate of deposit", "fixed deposit"]
  - name: SecurityPosition
    id_column: securities_positions.position_id
    description: "Brokerage position held in an account."
    synonyms: ["position", "holding", "portfolio line"]

tables:
  - name: customers
    entity: Customer
    description: "KYC profile for each customer."
    primary_key: customer_id
    columns:
      - name: customer_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: id
        description: "Surrogate key for customer"
      - name: full_name
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: name
        description: "Customer legal full name"
        synonyms: ["customer", "name", "client"]
      - name: email
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: email
        description: "Email address"
        pii: true
      - name: phone
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: phone
        description: "Phone number"
        pii: true
      - name: address
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: text
        description: "Mailing address"
        pii: true
      - name: kyc_status
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: status
        description: "KYC verification status"
        enum: ["PENDING", "VERIFIED", "REJECTED"]
        synonyms: ["kyc", "verification"]
      - name: risk_rating
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: rating
        description: "Operational risk score 1(low)-5(high)"
      - name: created_at
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: datetime
        description: "Customer profile creation timestamp"

  - name: accounts
    entity: Account
    description: "Bank accounts linked to customers."
    primary_key: account_id
    foreign_keys:
      - column: customer_id
        references: customers.customer_id
    columns:
      - name: account_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: id
        description: "Surrogate key for account"
      - name: customer_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: fk
        description: "Owning customer id"
      - name: account_type
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: category
        description: "Type of account"
        enum: ["CHECKING", "SAVINGS", "BROKERAGE"]
        synonyms: ["type", "kind", "product"]
      - name: currency
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: currency
        description: "ISO currency code"
        default: "USD"
      - name: opened_date
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: date
        description: "Account open date"
      - name: status
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: status
        description: "Account lifecycle status"
        enum: ["OPEN", "FROZEN", "CLOSED"]
      - name: balance
        type: REAL
        semantic_type: amount
        description: "Current book balance in account currency"
        synonyms: ["cash", "funds", "available balance"]

  - name: transactions
    entity: Transaction
    description: "Monetary transactions associated with accounts."
    primary_key: txn_id
    foreign_keys:
      - column: account_id
        references: accounts.account_id
    columns:
      - name: txn_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: id
        description: "Transaction id"
      - name: account_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: fk
        description: "Linked account id"
      - name: txn_time
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: datetime
        description: "Transaction timestamp"
        synonyms: ["date", "posted_at", "time"]
      - name: amount
        type: REAL
        semantic_type: amount
        description: "Signed amount (+ inflow, - outflow)"
        synonyms: ["value", "money"]
      - name: currency
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: currency
        description: "Transaction currency"
      - name: txn_type
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: category
        description: "High-level type"
        enum: ["DEPOSIT", "WITHDRAWAL", "TRANSFER_IN", "TRANSFER_OUT", "SEC_BUY", "SEC_SELL", "INTEREST"]
        synonyms: ["type", "kind", "category", "code"]
      - name: description
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: text
        description: "Free-text narrative"
      - name: counterparty_account
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: number
        description: "Counterparty account if internal transfer"

  - name: time_deposits
    entity: TimeDeposit
    description: "Certificates of deposit / fixed term deposits."
    primary_key: deposit_id
    foreign_keys:
      - column: account_id
        references: accounts.account_id
    columns:
      - name: deposit_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: id
        description: "CD id"
      - name: account_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: fk
        description: "Linked deposit account id"
      - name: start_date
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: date
        description: "Start date"
      - name: maturity_date
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: date
        description: "Maturity date"
      - name: principal
        type: REAL
        semantic_type: amount
        description: "Principal amount"
      - name: interest_rate
        type: REAL
        semantic_type: fraction
        description: "Annual rate (e.g., 0.035)"
      - name: status
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: status
        description: "CD status"
        enum: ["ACTIVE", "MATURED", "REDEEMED"]

  - name: securities_positions
    entity: SecurityPosition
    description: "Brokerage positions for investment accounts."
    primary_key: position_id
    foreign_keys:
      - column: account_id
        references: accounts.account_id
    columns:
      - name: position_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: id
        description: "Position id"
      - name: account_id
        type: INTEGER
        semantic_type: fk
        description: "Owning brokerage account id"
      - name: symbol
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: ticker
        description: "Security symbol"
        synonyms: ["ticker"]
      - name: instrument_type
        type: TEXT
        semantic_type: category
        description: "Asset class"
        enum: ["STOCK", "BOND", "ETF", "FUND"]
      - name: quantity
        type: REAL
        semantic_type: number
        description: "Units held"
      - name: avg_price
        type: REAL
        semantic_type: amount
        description: "Average cost per unit"
      - name: last_price
        type: REAL
        semantic_type: amount
        description: "Latest mark price (nullable)"

relationships:
  - name: customer_has_accounts
    left_table: customers
    right_table: accounts
    join: "customers.customer_id = accounts.customer_id"
    cardinality: one_to_many

  - name: account_has_transactions
    left_table: accounts
    right_table: transactions
    join: "accounts.account_id = transactions.account_id"
    cardinality: one_to_many

  - name: account_has_time_deposits
    left_table: accounts
    right_table: time_deposits
    join: "accounts.account_id = time_deposits.account_id"
    cardinality: one_to_many

  - name: account_has_positions
    left_table: accounts
    right_table: securities_positions
    join: "accounts.account_id = securities_positions.account_id"
    cardinality: one_to_many

dimensions:
  date:
    definitions:
      txn_date: "date(transactions.txn_time)"
      txn_month: "strftime('%Y-%m', transactions.txn_time)"
      txn_year: "strftime('%Y', transactions.txn_time)"
      opened_month: "strftime('%Y-%m', accounts.opened_date)"
      maturity_month: "strftime('%Y-%m', time_deposits.maturity_date)"
  categorical:
    definitions:
      account_type: "accounts.account_type"
      account_status: "accounts.status"
      kyc_status: "customers.kyc_status"
      instrument_type: "securities_positions.instrument_type"
      symbol: "securities_positions.symbol"
  entity_keys:
    definitions:
      customer_id: "customers.customer_id"
      account_id: "accounts.account_id"

metrics:
  - name: total_balance
    label: "Total Book Balance"
    description: "Sum of current account balances (all accounts)."
    type: aggregation
    expression: "SUM(accounts.balance)"
    grain: bank
    joins: ["customer_has_accounts"]

  - name: inflows
    label: "Total Inflows"
    description: "Sum of positive transaction amounts (including deposits, interest, transfer_in)."
    type: aggregation
    expression: "SUM(CASE WHEN transactions.amount > 0 THEN transactions.amount ELSE 0 END)"
    grain: account
    joins: ["account_has_transactions"]

  - name: outflows
    label: "Total Outflows"
    description: "Absolute sum of negative transaction amounts (withdrawals, transfer_out, security buys)."
    type: aggregation
    expression: "ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN transactions.amount < 0 THEN transactions.amount ELSE 0 END))"
    grain: account
    joins: ["account_has_transactions"]

  - name: net_flows
    label: "Net Flows"
    description: "Inflows minus Outflows over the selected period."
    type: derived
    expression: "({{inflows}} - {{outflows}})"
    grain: account

  - name: interest_earned
    label: "Interest Earned"
    description: "Sum of INTEREST transactions."
    type: aggregation
    expression: "SUM(CASE WHEN transactions.txn_type = 'INTEREST' THEN transactions.amount ELSE 0 END)"
    grain: account
    joins: ["account_has_transactions"]

  - name: cd_principal
    label: "CD Principal"
    description: "Sum of principal across ACTIVE time deposits."
    type: aggregation
    expression: "SUM(CASE WHEN time_deposits.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN time_deposits.principal ELSE 0 END)"
    grain: account
    joins: ["account_has_time_deposits"]

  - name: portfolio_market_value
    label: "Portfolio Market Value"
    description: "Mark-to-market value using last_price when available; fallback to avg_price."
    type: aggregation
    expression: "SUM(securities_positions.quantity * COALESCE(securities_positions.last_price, securities_positions.avg_price))"
    grain: account
    joins: ["account_has_positions"]

  - name: positions_count
    label: "Count of Positions"
    description: "Number of securities positions."
    type: aggregation
    expression: "COUNT(securities_positions.position_id)"
    grain: account
    joins: ["account_has_positions"]

  - name: active_customers
    label: "Active Customers"
    description: "Customers with at least one OPEN account."
    type: aggregation
    expression: "COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN accounts.status = 'OPEN' THEN customers.customer_id END)"
    grain: bank
    joins: ["customer_has_accounts"]

views:
  - name: v_account_txn_daily
    description: "Daily net flow by account."
    sql: |
      SELECT
        a.account_id,
        date(t.txn_time) AS txn_date,
        SUM(t.amount)    AS net_amount
      FROM accounts a
      JOIN transactions t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
      GROUP BY 1,2

  - name: v_portfolio_holdings
    description: "Current holdings with market value."
    sql: |
      SELECT
        a.account_id,
        sp.symbol,
        sp.instrument_type,
        sp.quantity,
        sp.avg_price,
        COALESCE(sp.last_price, sp.avg_price) AS price,
        (sp.quantity * COALESCE(sp.last_price, sp.avg_price)) AS market_value
      FROM accounts a
      JOIN securities_positions sp ON sp.account_id = a.account_id

intents:
  - utterances: ["total cash on hand", "sum of balances", "bank balance overall"]
    map:
      metric: total_balance

  - utterances: ["net cash flow last month", "money in minus out in October"]
    map:
      metric: net_flows
      where:
        - "strftime('%Y-%m', transactions.txn_time) = '{{period}}'"

  - utterances: ["portfolio value for brokerage accounts", "total holdings market value"]
    map:
      metric: portfolio_market_value
      where:
        - "accounts.account_type = 'BROKERAGE'"

  - utterances: ["active customers", "customers with open accounts"]
    map:
      metric: active_customers

governance:
  pii_columns:
    - customers.email
    - customers.phone
    - customers.address
  policies:
    - name: suppress_pii_by_default
      rule: "MASK() on pii_columns unless role in ('admin','compliance')"

samples:
  - q: "Show top 5 accounts by balance"
    sql: |
      SELECT account_id, balance
      FROM accounts
      WHERE status = 'OPEN'
      ORDER BY balance DESC
      LIMIT 5;

  - q: "Monthly net flows for checking accounts"
    sql: |
      SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', t.txn_time) AS month,
        SUM(t.amount) AS net_flows
      FROM transactions t
      JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
      WHERE a.account_type = 'CHECKING'
      GROUP BY 1
      ORDER BY 1;

  - q: "Portfolio market value by customer"
    sql: |
      SELECT
        c.full_name,
        SUM(sp.quantity * COALESCE(sp.last_price, sp.avg_price)) AS market_value
      FROM customers c
      JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
      JOIN securities_positions sp ON sp.account_id = a.account_id
      GROUP BY 1
      ORDER BY market_value DESC;
                ---

                QUESTION:
                Which customer has the highest total balance?

                SQL:
data.systemPrompt: Output only the SQL SELECT statement for SQLite. No prose.

response.content:
SELECT c.full_name, SUM(a.balance) as total_balance
FROM customers c
JOIN accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.full_name
ORDER BY total_balance DESC
LIMIT 1
